title: A petition is approved with an invisible name (zero-width characters only), and a problem made only of zero-width characters passes the 5-character minimum

title: The desk's mobile box turns '+91 98400 12345', typed as written on the paper, into '9198400123', a valid-looking number that belongs to someone else. '098400 12345' becomes '0984001234', which the server also accepts. The petitioner cannot track with their real last 4 digits, and in live mode the SMS with the complaint number would go to a stranger
repro: node tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/hunt2-desk/ui4.mjs <a waiting petition id> (360 px desk; types '+91 98400 12345' into Mobile; approves nothing); node tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/hunt2-desk/p6.mjs (API filing and tracking)

where: src/lib/manu/petitions.ts:179 (regex /^(\d{10})?$/ only); src/components/manu/ManuDesk.tsx:223 (maxLength={10} plus replace(/\D/g,'') cuts a typed or pasted '0' or '+91' number to its first 10 characters)
